description: Send desktop notifications when Claude Code needs your attention. Transmitted as a terminal escape sequence, so it works even when Claude runs over SSH. Requires an OSC 9-capable local terminal (e.g. iTerm2); in tmux, needs `tmux set -g allow-passthrough all`.

hooks.command: msg='\033]9;✴️ Claude requires attention\007'; [ -n "$TMUX" ] && msg='\033Ptmux;\033'"$msg"'\033\\'; printf '%b' "$msg" > /dev/tty 2>/dev/null
